title: Question 12
author: 65197ebd8a6b1841b92c3592
chapter_outcomes: Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of ICT including: hardware and software, analogue and digital data, the main components of computer systems (CPU, internal memory, input and output devices, backing storage), operating systems, types of computer (desktop computer, mobile computers), emerging technologies

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of input and output devices including: characteristics, uses, advantages and disadvantages of input devices (keyboard, numeric keypad, pointing devices, remote control, joystick/driving wheel, touch screen as input device, scanners, camera, microphone, sensors, light pen), direct data entry devices (magnetic stripe reader, chip and PIN reader, RFID reader, OMR, OCR, bar code reader, QR scanner), output devices (monitors, touch screen as output device, multimedia projector, laser printer, inkjet printer, dot matrix printer, plotter, 3D printers, speaker, actuator)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of storage devices and media including: characteristics, uses, media, advantages and disadvantages of magnetic drives (fixed and portable magnetic hard drives, magnetic tape drives), optical drives (CD, DVD, Blu-ray), fixed and portable solid-state drive (SSD, pen drive, flash drive), storage media (magnetic hard disks, magnetic tape, optical discs CD/DVD/Blu-ray, memory cards SD/xD/CFast)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of networks including: operation and purpose of a router (connecting networks and devices to the internet, storing computer addresses in a router, routing data packets), common network devices (NIC, hubs, bridges, switches), uses of wi-fi and Bluetooth, connecting a device to a network using wi-fi or Bluetooth, similarities and differences between Bluetooth and wi-fi, characteristics/uses/issues relating to cloud computing, how data is stored/managed/shared using cloud computing, advantages and disadvantages of using cloud storage compared to other methods, characteristics/uses/purpose of extranet/intranet/internet, differences and similarities between extranet/intranet/internet, network types (LAN, WLAN, WAN) and differences between these networks

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of network issues and communication including: security issues regarding data transfer (privacy and confidentiality), avoiding password interception by using up to date anti-spyware and regularly changing passwords, differences between strong and weak passwords, other authentication methods (zero login, biometric methods, magnetic stripes, smart cards, physical tokens, electronic tokens), use of anti-malware and anti-virus software, operation of removing/quarantining viruses using up to date software, scanning storage media used to transfer data, scanning data/software when downloading, characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of electronic conferencing (video-conferencing, audio-conferencing, web-conferencing), hardware/software/network connection required to set up each type of electronic conference

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of the effects of using IT including: positive and negative effects of microprocessors/smart devices in monitoring and controlling devices in the home (impact on lifestyle, leisure time, physical fitness, security of data, degree of social interaction), positive and negative effects of microprocessors/smart devices in monitoring and controlling transport (security of data, autonomous vehicles, transport safety)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of potential health problems related to prolonged use of IT equipment including: health issues (RSI, back problems, eye problems, headaches), causes of these health issues and strategies for preventing them

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of ICT applications including: characteristics and uses of communication media (newsletters, posters, websites, multimedia presentations, audio, video, media streaming, ePublications), use of mobile devices for communication (SMS messaging, phone calls, VoIP, video calls, accessing the internet), computer modelling (personal finance, bridge and building design, flood water management, traffic management, weather forecasting), advantages and disadvantages of using computer modelling rather than humans, computer controlled systems (robotics in manufacture, production line control, autonomous vehicles), advantages and disadvantages of using computer controlled systems rather than humans, school management systems (managing learner registration and attendance, recording learner performance including computer aided learning), characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of online booking systems (travel industry, concerts, cinemas, sporting events), banking applications including characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of ATM (withdrawing cash, depositing cash or cheques, checking account balance, mini statements, bill paying, money transfers), EFT, credit/debit card transactions, cheques, internet banking, information systems in medicine (characteristics and uses of patient records, pharmacy records), 3D printers (printing of prosthetics, tissue engineering, artificial blood vessels, customised medicines)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of expert systems including: characteristics/uses/purpose of expert systems (mineral prospecting, car engine fault diagnosis, medical diagnosis, chess games, financial planning, route scheduling for delivery vehicles, plant and animal identification), components of an expert system (user interface, inference engine, knowledge base, rules base, explanation system), how an expert system is used to produce possible solutions for different scenarios

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of computers in the retail industry including: characteristics and uses of computers in retail industry (POS terminals, EFTPOS terminals), POS terminals (updating stock files automatically, ordering new stock automatically), EFTPOS terminals (checking validity of cards, use of chip and PIN, use of contactless cards, use of NFC payment, communication between supermarket computer and bank computer), characteristics/advantages/disadvantages of internet shopping

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of recognition systems including: characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of OMR (school registers, multiple-choice examination papers, barcode, QR code), OCR (ANPR systems), RFID (tracking stock, passports, automobiles, contactless payment), NFC (payment using a smartphone), biometric recognition (face, iris, retina, finger, thumb, hand, voice)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of satellite systems including: characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of satellite systems (GPS, satellite navigation, GIS, media communication systems - satellite television, satellite phone)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of the systems life cycle including: analysis of current system (characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of research methods - observation, interviews, questionnaires, examination of existing documents), need to identify inputs/outputs/processing of current system, problems with current system, user and information requirements for new system, system specification (identify and justify suitable hardware and software for new system), design (file/data structures including field length/field name/data type/coding of data, validation routines including range check/character check/length check/type check/format check/presence check/check digit, input formats including data capture forms, output formats including screen layouts and report layouts), development and testing (need to test system before implementation, test designs/test strategies/test plan - test data/expected outcomes/actual outcomes/remedial action following testing, test designs including testing of data structures/file structures/input formats/output formats/validation routines, test strategies including to test each module/each function/whole system, definition/characteristics/use of test data using normal/abnormal/extreme data, use of live data), implementation (characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of four methods of implementation - direct changeover, parallel running, pilot running, phased implementation), documentation (characteristics/uses/purpose of technical and user documentation, components of technical documentation including purpose of system/program, limitations of system, program listing, program language, program flowcharts/algorithms, system flowcharts, hardware and software requirements, file structures, list of variables, input format, output format, sample runs/test runs, validation routines; components of user documentation including purpose of system, limitations of system, hardware and software requirements, how to load/run/install software, how to save a file, how to print data, how to add records, how to delete/edit records, input format, output format, sample runs, error messages, error handling, troubleshooting guide/helpline, frequently asked questions, glossary of terms), evaluation (evaluate a solution including efficiency of solution, ease of use of solution, appropriateness of solution, compare solution with original task requirements, identify any limitations and necessary improvements to system, evaluate users' responses to results of testing the system)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of safety and security including: physical safety issues (electrocution from spilling drinks near electrical equipment and touching live cables, fire from sockets being overloaded or equipment overheating, tripping over trailing cables, heavy equipment falling and injuring people), causes of these safety issues and strategies for preventing them, principles of a typical data protection act and why data protection legislation is required, characteristics of personal and sensitive data (personal name, address, date of birth, photograph in school uniform, medical history), need for personal data to be kept confidential and protected to avoid inappropriate disclosure, need for eSafety when using internet/email/social media/online gaming, minimise potential danger of using the internet (only using trusted websites recommended by teachers, using a search engine that only allows access to age appropriate websites), minimise potential danger of using email (awareness of potential dangers of opening or replying to email from unknown person, awareness of risks associated with sending personal identifiable data or images via email), minimise potential danger of using social media (knowing how to block and report unwanted users, awareness of potential dangers of meeting an online contact face to face, avoiding distribution of inappropriate images, avoiding use of inappropriate language, respecting confidentiality of personal data of other people), minimise potential danger of using online gaming (not using real names, not giving out personal or financial data), characteristics and effect of threats to data (hacking, phishing, pharming, smishing, vishing, viruses, malware, card fraud), hacking (measures that must be taken to protect data), phishing/pharming/smishing/vishing (methods that can be used to help prevent them), viruses and malware (how to take preventative action to avoid danger of infecting a computer from a downloaded file), card fraud (shoulder surfing, card cloning, key logging), characteristics and methods of protecting data (biometrics, digital certificate, SSL, encryption, firewall, two-factor authentication, user id and password), biometrics (use of biometric data), digital certificate (purpose and contents), SSL (encrypted links between server and client computer), encryption (purpose for protection of data on hard discs/email/cloud/HTTPS websites), firewall (purpose), two-factor authentication (purpose and function), user id and password (how they are used to increase security of data)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of audience including: show clear sense of audience and purpose, planning ICT solutions that are responsive to and respectful of needs of an audience, analyse needs of an audience when creating ICT solutions

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of copyright including: need for copyright legislation and principles of copyright relating to computer software (e.g. software piracy), methods that software producers employ to prevent software copyright legislation being broken

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of communication including: characteristics/uses/constraints of email communication (acceptable language, guidelines set by employer, need for security, netiquette, email groups, cc, bcc, forward, attachments), characteristics and effects of spam email (methods which can be used to help prevent spam), characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of using the internet (differences between internet/intranet/extranet/WWW, blog, forum, wiki, social networking), functionality (ISP, structure of web address, URL, hyperlink, web browser), use of search engine (speed of searching, amount of information, speed of finding relevant information, ease of finding reliable information), evaluating information found on internet (how up to date, reliable, biased and valid this information is), internet protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SSL), risks of using internet (inappropriate and criminal material, restricting data through parental/educational/ISP control)

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of file management including: characteristics and uses of file formats (css, csv, gif, htm, jpg, pdf, png, rtf, txt, zip, rar), need for generic file formats, need to reduce file sizes for storage or transmission
Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of images including: recognise that reducing file size can be achieved by reducing image resolution or colour depth
Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of styles including: purpose and uses of a corporate house style

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of proofing including: automated suggestions given by spell check software do not always give correct response, importance/characteristics/uses of appropriate validation (range check, character check, length check, type check, format check, presence check), importance/characteristics/uses of verification (visual checking, double data entry to reduce data entry errors), need for validation as well as verification
Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of document production including: purpose of setting page/section/column breaks, purpose of setting gutter margins

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of databases including: characteristics/uses/advantages/disadvantages of flat file and relational database, characteristics of primary key and foreign keys, characteristics of good form design

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of spreadsheets including: difference between a formula and a function, order in which mathematical operations are performed including use of brackets to make sure that formulae work, characteristics and use of absolute and relative cell referencing

Recall, select and communicate knowledge and understanding of website authoring including: content layer is used to enter content and create structure of a web page, presentation layer is used to display and format elements within a web page, behaviour layer is for a scripting language to control elements within a web page, purpose of head and body sections of a web page, reason tables are used to structure elements within a web page, function of metatags (to define charset, keywords for search engines, author of web page, description of web page, viewport to make web page display on all devices), function of a hyperlink, concept of a bookmark including methods of creating a bookmark within a web page, function of an anchor, relative file path and absolute file path including reason absolute file paths must not be used for hyperlinks to locally saved web pages/objects, characteristics of cascading stylesheets (difference between attached stylesheets and inline style attributes, hierarchy of multiple attached stylesheets and inline styles within a web page), characteristics of a style and a class including difference between them, reason relative file paths must be used for attached stylesheets
Analyse, evaluate, make reasoned judgements and present conclusions
